findings.action: Residual of R1-N1: the guard tests that the raw line starts with # but judges the heading on the comment-stripped text. After "- L1: ... a shim covers it", the unindented line "#<!----> of cases only on Linux." (or "###<!-- c --> only on Linux."), which as written is no Markdown heading, closes the section: L1 is sealed cut, a following L2 is dropped, and no problem is reported. The base engine refused the section. It contradicts the manual and the execution log (a heading as written). Judging headingLine on raw as well would close it. Low because a comment glued to a hash is contrived.

The R1-N2 fix truncates each whole message at 300 bytes, and the reason comes after the quoted line (line 78). For any offending line of about 270 bytes or more the message loses what it refuses: malformed bullet, prose line and nested list all end in an ellipsis with no "is not written as", "is neither a limit" or "is a nested list". Limits in this repository are single lines of that length. The base engine printed the reason. R4 requires messages that say what they refuse and are bounded; truncate the quoted line, not the message. The new size test does not assert that the reason survives.
The doc comment of PreflightReviewAttestation still says it returns the reasons the writer would refuse an approving attestation, although it now also refuses non-approving ones.
